criteria.notes: The kiosk provides ordinary authored 2D and 3D exploration, a complete exploded 3D route, camera movement, datasource status, and visitor-triggered spoken guidance without Atlas or step controls.
The 2D map, 3D projection, polygon styling, labels, imagery, floor explosion, route hierarchy, and camera states come from canonical Editor Preview primitives.
The result reads as a dedicated architectural directory with a persistent destination rail, map-dominant stage, restrained detail context, and compact controls.
All declared near-touch text roles pass their computed font floors at 1920x1080; route and destination actions remain legible.
Dark, light, and custom shell palettes retain hierarchy while leaving authored map presentation unchanged; status is not conveyed by color alone.
Long venue and welcome copy use their declared fit policies; destination, status, and route text remain unclipped.
Every captured state measures 98% width and 100% height content coverage; the directory scroll region remains intentional and touch reachable.
Map artwork and destination photography render sharply; ordinary 3D has clear volume and the exploded route preserves indoor and outdoor path contrast.
No outdated repository example was used as authority; the shell is purpose-built around the Editor-owned mini-displayer boundary.
